description:
About the Scholarship

The University of Canterbury Doctoral Scholarship supports eligible research students across disciplines. Applicants need both a scholarship submission and an admission application. The October round is intended for candidates starting their doctoral studies before July 2027.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Canterbury PhD subjects
  • Doctoral research
  • Research training

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 32,650 per 120 points, plus thesis tuition

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsStart before 1 July 2027; doctoral admission application also required.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 October 2026
LocationNew Zealand

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About University of Canterbury

Canterbury offers doctoral study and university-funded scholarships in Christchurch. Applicants can seek general doctoral funding or compete for scholarships linked to a particular research project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

Official Link

https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/scholarships/doctoral-scholarships/uc-doctoral-scholarships

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.
